methods.description: Read original Leaflet camera/wheel code; test cumulative normalized input, focal alignment, cancellation, bounds, picking and ownership invariants in a fresh browser fixture and actual current-data app

Synthetic trusted wheel events; sampled rAF gaps and first observed CSS/draw change, trace tasks/draws, viewport traversal, downloads and ownership counters. Frozen source/provider/condition vintages; no photon or physical-device claim. All metrics archived to their original measurement source rather than relabeled for a later source clamp or live delivery.
methods.software: Playwright and Chromium versions/GPU recorded in each receipt; no user profile or artificial CPU/network throttle
